content.text: The tuple gain is marginal (Python iteration-bound). Let me add a settled-node skip and re-measure the real workload:

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/submission && python3 - << 'EOF'
src = open('solver.py').read()
old = """        while hq:
            d, u = heappop(hq)
            du = dist[u]
            if du is None or d != du:
                continue
            if u == t:
                return dist, prevv, preve, d
            nd_base = du + pi[u]
            for ei in adj[u]:
                if cap[ei] <= 0:
                    continue
                v = to[ei]
                nd = nd_base + cost[ei] - pi[v]
                dv = dist[v]
                if dv is None or nd < dv:
                    dist[v] = nd
                    prevv[v] = u
                    preve[v] = ei
                    heappush(hq, (nd, v))
        return dist, prevv, preve, None
"""
new = """        done = [False] * n
        while hq:
            d, u = heappop(hq)
            du = dist[u]
            if du is None or d != du:
                continue
            if u == t:
                return dist, prevv, preve, d
            done[u] = True
            nd_base = du + pi[u]
            for ei in adj[u]:
                if cap[ei] <= 0:
                    continue
                v = to[ei]
                if done[v]:
                    continue
                nd = nd_base + cost[ei] - pi[v]
                dv = dist[v]
                if dv is None or nd < dv:
                    dist[v] = nd
                    prevv[v] = u
                    preve[v] = ei
                    heappush(hq, (nd, v))
        return dist, prevv, preve, None
"""
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, new)
open('solver.py','w').write(src)
print('ok')
EOF
